name: William Donald Stone MD DDS
education: DDS and MD, Emory University, Atlanta
biography: William "Bill" Donald Stone was born October 11, 1921 in Portsmouth, VA, and raised in Raleigh, NC. He attended UNC Chapel Hill, where he was a competitive swimmer, then earned both his DDS and MD from Emory University — one of the only doctors in Atlanta to hold both medicine and dentistry licenses through the 1960s–80s. He served in the US Navy during WWII, and was a founding member and past president of the Civil War Round Table of Atlanta. He collected war memorabilia, artwork, antique automobiles, stamps, and coins, and enjoyed organic gardening, welding, world travel, and woodworking. He was previously married to Lucy Stone, with whom he had four children — Charlene, Marlene, Darlene, and Arlene — before marrying Gloria Claus Stone in 1967; he and Gloria spent many years together in Atlanta and at their home on Lake Allatoona in Woodstock, GA, where he retired. He died February 7, 2010, at age 88.
